dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Oh... Finch has grown old, has he...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: When I first arrived here from Fontaine, he was still a little crybaby.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But as his teardrops mingled with the spring water, I sensed his good and gentle nature.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: He was the first friend I made in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Why won't you see him anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: My kind lives long lives... very long lives...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: If there must be a painful parting, better that it happen earlier, to avoid the deep lake of grief... better that it be but a droplet, whisked away by the surging river of time, then lost in the vast ocean of memory...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Forgive me... I just couldn't face it, I... I'm sorry...
